decisions.reason: It remained prominently presented over two years, fits the core lighting range, and in a growing industry a broad-range firm with some slack has little reason to search for an alternative use of these resources.

Its continued dedicated presentation suggests performance at least near aspiration, and as a close-to-core ceiling luminaire it is easy to support within the firm's established capabilities and channel relationships.
Although newer and therefore less proven, it has its own page and sits close to the established spotlight offer, so boundedly rational management would likely continue it while learning more.
As a system-complement product building on the existing offer, it likely supports the wider range and dealer/planner value proposition, which raises tolerance for uncertain standalone results.
This canopy extends the modular system logic and probably benefits from organisational slack and strategic fit, even if its individual sales may still be developing.

It is only mentioned rather than strongly featured, which signals weaker evidence of success, but its close fit with the design-led track range and the firm's broad assortment still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
